description: Holds an open time at a business for a person and texts them a link to confirm it. Nothing is booked, and the business isn't told, until they tap Confirm within 15 minutes; otherwise the time is released. After they confirm, the business accepts the request (or it's confirmed at once at instant-book businesses). Payment is at the business. Requires the person's name and US mobile number; the confirmation link is texted to that number. Businesses that take a card when booking return a booking page link instead of a hold.

business.description: The business slug or lokuli.com/shop/... link

email.description: Optional email for the business's confirmation

notes.description: Optional note for the business (300 characters max)

phone.description: The person's US mobile number; the confirmation link is texted here

service_id.description: The id of the service to book

start.description: The open slot's start time (ISO), exactly as listed in the business's open times

name: book_appointment
title: Book an appointment (confirmed by text)
